name: My Wolf
source:
Delve deep into indulgence and lack there of, sink into the depravity of the world around you and ascend from it.

[From [url=https://hyponova.itch.io/my-wolf]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
探入纵欲与匮乏的深处，沉入身边这个堕落的世界，再从中挣脱，向上攀升。

〔摘自[url=https://hyponova.itch.io/my-wolf]itch.io[/url]〕
